title: ee.mesh.disable_result.v1
description: Result envelope emitted by the SRR6.46.9 `ee mesh disable [--workspace .] [--reason "..."] [--dry-run] [--json]` command. Reports the rollback the command performed (or would have performed under --dry-run): peer-group binding removed, peer-group row deleted IFF no other workspace bindings retain it, trust assignments cleared, audit row id. The reversal path SRR6.46.5's reversalCommand field promises operators.

outcome.description: `disabled`: rollback completed; bindings + trust + peer-group row cleaned per the bead's step 5 contract. `dry_run`: --dry-run requested; steps 1-4 ran (lock + resolve + audit row) but step 5 was skipped. `noop_no_peer_group`: workspace has no materialized peer-group, so nothing to roll back; emitted with the `mesh_disable_noop` info-severity caution.

removedPeerGroupId.description: Peer-group id that was unlinked (always set when outcome=disabled OR outcome=dry_run; null when outcome=noop_no_peer_group).

auditRowId.description: Id of the ee_audit row emitted with event_type=mesh.auto_enrollment_rolled_back. Always present (even on dry-run) so the audit log records every attempted disable.

dryRun.description: True when the caller passed --dry-run. Step 5 (durable mutation) is skipped when true; the schema shape is otherwise identical so renderers don't branch.

userReason.description: Verbatim --reason argument passed by the operator, stored on the audit row. Null when --reason was omitted.

removedPeerCount.description: Number of peers that were members of the disabled peer-group at the moment the audit row was emitted. Counts the peers, not the bindings.

removedBindings.description: Number of workspace-id -> peer-group binding rows removed. Typically 1 (just this workspace's binding); always 0 under outcome=noop_no_peer_group.

bindingsRetainedForOtherWorkspaces.description: Number of OTHER workspaces that still bind to the same peer-group. When this is >0, the peer-group row itself is NOT deleted (only this workspace's binding is unlinked) so other workspaces keep their materialized trust state. When this is 0 the peer-group row is deleted along with this workspace's binding.

cautions.description: UX hazard signals the renderer surfaces visually. Closed set: `mesh_disable_noop`, `mesh_disable_bindings_retained`, `mesh_disable_dry_run`. Severity is `info` or `warning` only; `error` is not a path this command takes (errors propagate as the response envelope's top-level error block, not via cautions).
